about: Where each number on kolaboro.com comes from. Pages mark a number with data-prov="id" (or are matched by 'attach' selectors); /k/prov.js opens a panel that re-reads the source in the browser. Expressions: a.b.c, arr[key=value].field, count(path), sum(path, path), cond ? path : path. 'recompute' counts again from raw records; 'twin' is a signed endpoint that must carry the same number; 'dataset' compares the file's SHA-256 with the signed /api/open/log-input.
